rules.about: Baseline 1986 corrections to the OpenStreetMap place names (data/pois/osm.json). Rules match names by regular expression (case-insensitive); 'near' limits a rule to within 'radius' metres (default 200) of a point. A rule can hide a place, rename it, change its kind, or mark it 'kept' (known to have been there in 1986, so it shows with its name even when other businesses are hidden or generic). 'added' lists places that were there in 1986 and are gone now. 'zones' hide every business inside a box that was empty, industrial or parking in 1986. 'brands' are chains that arrived in Boston after 1986. Confidence: 'sure' (well documented), 'likely', or 'approx' (the place is right but the position is estimated). The GM's in-game edits are stored separately and override all of this.
